changeauthor-desc: Waxay oggolaanaysaa beddelidda qoraaga dib u eegista.
changeauthor-pagename-or-revid: Magaca bogga ama aqoonsiga dib u eegista:
changeauthor-explanation-multi:
Foomkan waxaad ku beddeli kartaa qorayaasha dib u eegista.
Si fudud u beddel hal ama in ka badan oo magacyada isticmaalayaasha ah ee ku jira liiska hoose, ku dar faallo (ikhtiyaari), kadibna guji badhanka "Beddel qoraaga/qorayaasha".
changeauthor-explanation-single:
Foomkan waxaad ku beddeli kartaa qoraaga dib-u-eegista.
Si fudud u beddel magaca isticmaalaha ee hoose, ku dar faallo (ikhtiyaari), kadibna guji badhanka "Beddel qoraaga".
changeauthor-weirderror:
Khalad aad u yaab badan ayaa dhacay.
Fadlan mar kale isku day codsigaaga.
Haddii khaladkani uu sii muuqdo, kaydka xogta ayaa laga yaabaa inuu xumaaday.
changeauthor-invalidform: Fadlan isticmaal foomka uu bixiyo [[Special:ChangeAuthor|bogga gaarka ah]] halkii aad ka isticmaali lahayd foom gaar ah.
changeauthor-success: Codsigaaga si guul leh ayaa loo fuliyay.
log-description-changeauth: Kani waa diiwaanka isbeddellada lagu sameeyay qorayaasha dib u eegista.
logentry-changeauth-changeauth: $1 wuxuu beddelay qoraaga {{int:Changeauthor-rev|$4}} ee $3 laga bilaabo $5 loona beddelay $6
